note: SYNTHETIC example — not customer data, not a measured trace. Deterministic prevention rules mapped from a small synthetic finding set.

syntheticFindings.title: Repeated failed builds with broad edits

preventionRules.title: Redundant file read
preventionRules.cause: The same file is re-read without an intervening edit, re-loading context that was already available.
preventionRules.fixNow: Reuse the already-read file contents instead of re-reading the same file.
preventionRules.promptFix: Before reading a file, check whether it was already read and not modified since.
preventionRules.policyRule: Warn when a file is read more than once with no edit between reads in the same run.
evidenceNeeded: Repeated read of the same path
No edit recorded between the reads
limitations: Detected from structured evidence only; not every redundant read is observable.
No measured token/cost impact is claimed.

preventionRules.title: Build-fix loop
preventionRules.cause: Repeated broad edits and rebuilds without isolating the first failing file or root error.
preventionRules.fixNow: Stop broad edits and isolate the first failing file/error.
preventionRules.promptFix: After two failed builds, enter diagnostic mode before another edit.
preventionRules.policyRule: After two failed build attempts, ban unrelated file edits until the root error is identified.
evidenceNeeded: Two or more failed build attempts
Edits across unrelated files between builds
limitations: Loop count is read from structured evidence; latency/cost of the loop is not measured.

preventionRules.title: Claims drift
preventionRules.cause: Public copy or report text asserts claims that exceed what the measured/normalized fields support.
preventionRules.fixNow: Remove or qualify unsupported public claims.
preventionRules.promptFix: Only make claims supported by trace evidence or marked as future roadmap.
preventionRules.policyRule: Block report/public-copy generation if claims exceed measured fields.
evidenceNeeded: Absence of measured fields supporting the claim
limitations: Heuristic over text; it flags risk, it does not verify factual accuracy.

preventionRules.title: Missing usage metadata
preventionRules.cause: Model calls lack explicit usage metadata, so exact tokens and cost cannot be reported.
preventionRules.fixNow: Require provider usage metadata or mark cost/tokens unknown.
preventionRules.promptFix: Do not summarize cost unless usage fields are present.
preventionRules.policyRule: Fail cost reports when exact_token_count and exact_cost_usd are both null.
evidenceNeeded: Model calls with null token fields
Null exact_cost_usd in the normalized trace
limitations: This rule enforces honesty about unknowns; it never estimates the missing values.
